WITH customer_min_consumption AS (
    SELECT c.customerid, c.segment, MIN(ym.consumption) as consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.customerid = ym.customerid
    WHERE c.currency = 'CZK'
    AND ym.date >= '2013-01-01'
    AND ym.date < '2014-01-01'
    GROUP BY c.customerid, c.segment
),
min_per_segment AS (
    SELECT segment, MIN(consumption) as min_cons
    FROM customer_min_consumption
    GROUP BY segment
),
customers_with_min AS (
    SELECT cm.customerid, cm.segment
    FROM customer_min_consumption cm
    JOIN min_per_segment mp ON cm.segment = mp.segment AND cm.consumption = mp.min_cons
),
segment_avg_min AS (
    SELECT cm.segment, AVG(ym.consumption) as avg_consumption
    FROM customers_with_min cm
    JOIN yearmonth ym ON cm.customerid = ym.customerid
    WHERE ym.date >= '2013-01-01' AND ym.date < '2014-01-01'
    GROUP BY cm.segment
)
SELECT seg1.segment as seg1, seg2.segment as seg2, seg1.avg_consumption - seg2.avg_consumption as diff
FROM segment_avg_min seg1
CROSS JOIN segment_avg_min seg2

WITH segment_consumption AS (
    SELECT
        c.segment,
        SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(y.date, 'YYYYMM')) = 2012 THEN y.consumption ELSE 0 END) as consumption_2012,
        SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(y.date, 'YYYYMM')) = 2013 THEN y.consumption ELSE 0 END) as consumption_2013
    FROM customers c
    INNER JOIN yearmonth y ON c.customerid = y.customerid
    WHERE c.currency = 'EUR'
    AND c.segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c.segment
)
SELECT
    segment,
    consumption_2012,
    consumption_2013,
    ROUND(
        CASE WHEN consumption_2012 > 0 THEN (consumption_2013 - consumption_2012) * 100.0 / consumption_2012 ELSE 0 END::NUMERIC,
        2
    ) as percentage_increase
FROM segment_consumption
ORDER BY percentage_increase DESC

details.question: Which of the three segments—SME, LAM and KAM—has the biggest and lowest percentage increases in consumption paid in EUR between 2012 and 2013?
details.sql:
WITH segment_consumption AS (
    SELECT
        c.segment,
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(ym.date, 'YYYYMM')) as year,
        SUM(ym.consumption) as total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.customerid = ym.customerid
    WHERE c.currency = 'EUR'
    AND c.segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    AND TO_DATE(ym.date, 'YYYYMM') >= '2012-01-01'
    AND TO_DATE(ym.date, 'YYYYMM') < '2014-01-01'
    GROUP BY c.segment, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(ym.date, 'YYYYMM'))
),
segment_increase AS (
    SELECT
        s1.segment,
        s1.total_consumption as consumption_2012,
        s2.total_consumption as consumption_2013,
        ((s2.total_consumption - s1.total_consumption) * 100.0 / s1.total_consumption) as percentage_increase
    FROM segment_consumption s1
    JOIN segment_consumption s2 ON s1.segment = s2.segment
    WHERE s1.year = 2012 AND s2.year = 2013
),
segment_ranking AS (
    SELECT
        segment,
        percentage_increase,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY percentage_increase DESC) as rn_high,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY percentage_increase ASC) as rn_low
    FROM segment_increase
)
SELECT
    segment,
    percentage_increase as highest_increase
FROM segment_ranking
WHERE rn_high = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT
    segment,
    percentage_increase as lowest_increase
FROM segment_ranking
WHERE rn_low = 1
ORDER BY segment
